name: Aikomyu!! - Idol Communication-
source:
Tatsuya was a manager at the major idol company Atlas Productions, but he resigned after being frustrated at the direction of the office. He was offered a position at the former top idol Natsuka's no-name idol company Misakura Productions, where every day was an adventure – accidentally peeking at the girls changing, touching them in forbidden places…

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/05/25/may-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
达也曾是大型偶像公司Atlas Productions的经纪人，但对公司的发展方向感到失望后辞职了。他被前顶级偶像夏香旗下的无名偶像公司御樱Productions邀请就职，每天都是一场冒险——不小心偷看到女孩们换衣服、触碰到她们的禁区……

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/05/25/may-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
